ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Childcare Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial trails of childcare fraud in Minnesota, looking into the sources of funding and how it is being used.
questions: How is federal funding for childcare being used in Minnesota?
What measures are in place to prevent fraud and abuse?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we may be able to uncover patterns of fraud and abuse that have gone undetected, and shed light on the financial mechanisms that enable these schemes.
